review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_GAME_DIR set, CS_CAPABILITIES includes retail), plus a second production pass recorded in gun-damage-table.json. MEASURED: ZBD/zrdr.zbd member weapons.zrd, read through cs_formats::zbd and cs_content::original_airframe::SpannedDocument (span walk cross-checked against decode_zrd), holds twenty weapon records wep_30..33, wep_40..43, wep_50..53, wep_60..63 and wep_70..73 - the records the engine's (gun, ammunition kind) map at image VA 0x443d70 selects (bases 30,40,50,60,70, kinds 0..=3, committed in data/owner-static/engine-facts.toml) - and each states ARMOR_DAMAGE and HEALTH_DAMAGE as numbers, which the engine's record parser stores at weapon+0x4c and weapon+0x50 (static facts, rocket_splash_fact). Each of the forty amounts is returned by cs_content::weapons::read_original_gun_damage_table with a Provenance of class observed_tool naming its own bytes. cs_content::weapons::OriginalLimitReport records f27.d.limit.ammo_names_damage as bound on that observation. LIMITS, not claimed: the member states no unit, so the amounts are the engine's pool units unconverted; a type's amount differs per gun, so no type-wide ammunition profile is bound through bind_ammunition_damage; the channel mapping armor/health rests on static analysis, not on an original run; f27.d.limit.gun_group_assignment, convergence, inheritance and interaction_rules stay deferred and re-filed. The earlier F27-E.1 finding that no static route existed looked at langui.dll, the headers, crimson.exe, crimson.icd and planes.zbd and never at weapons.zrd. Nothing is verified_original and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval.
